description: This module introduces and attempts to solve the 2025 Advent of Code challenges in SPL, learning various commands and techniques along the way.
html:
What is advent of code?

Advent of Code is a free yearly Advent calendar of small programming puzzles made by Eric Wastl since 2015 at https://adventofcode.com/.

Whilst SPL is not really a programming language per say, it is probably more powerful than you think. This module attempts to solve the 2025 set of challenges and explores SPL along the way.

For each puzzle, https://adventofcode.com/ generates puzzle data unique to you. When you provide the correct answer for part 1 of a puzzle, it will unlock part 2.

Many thanks to the #puzzles channel people on the Splunk Community slack, some of these solutions are better thanks to them. Special thanks to ITWhisperer.

If you want more, check out my blog series about this topic, starting with day 1 and ITWhisperer's series starting at day 1
label: Advent of Code 2025

description: Solving day 1 of the 2025 Advent of Code in SPL
html:
Advent of Code 2025 - Day 1, the secret entrance safe

Go to https://adventofcode.com/2025/day/1 to read the puzzle description and get your individual puzzle data.

To be ready for this walk-through:

  • Save your full puzzle data as a text file
  • Edit it with a text editor to add a header line at the top saying rotation
  • Save it, then upload to splunk as a lookup file named adventofcode2025day1.csv.
label: AdventOfCode25 Day 1
